name: PLANT-1 M27
notes: M27: one seed, one plant — SEL grows both the timbre and the motif from the same seed (a base preset, then scale, genre, density and a few routes all derived from it). And A/B: on PATCH hold PLAY to store A, hold REC to store B, then turn K4 to morph every parameter between the two, discrete fields switching at the middle.
